title: An idea becomes a connected system — Mixed-Media Animation preview

scenes.title: Pencil idea on newsprint
scenes.purpose: Show the idea as a pencil sketch on a full-frame cool newsprint sheet (light ground, dark ink).
visuals: Full-frame cool newsprint (#DCE0D9) with seeded grain and faint ruling
Rough.js seeded pencil lightbulb that draws on as a line sweep

beats.development: The headline 'An idea becomes' wipes in at 0.1–0.6 s while the pencil bulb outline draws on from 0.15 s.
The copper filament lights in. At 0.78 s the right half of the sheet starts to lift from its top-right corner, opening a dark gap along the jagged tear edge.

scenes.title: Tear reveals the print layer
scenes.purpose: The ground swaps from figure to print: a paper tear reveals the dark slate dot-screen layer where the system assembles.
visuals: Right half of the newsprint rips away up and to the right, showing white fibre at the edges and a cast shadow
Deep slate ground with a stationary fine dot screen
Teal halftone disc with luminance-modulated dots builds as a radial wipe
Dashed construction guide ring turns, then drifts outward and fades
Teal and copper cut-paper nodes slam in, with misregistered offset echo layers converging toward register

beats.development: The torn piece accelerates off frame. The slate layer and the left newsprint remnant stay put.
The halftone disc completes its radial wipe. Nodes A, B, D and C land in sequence (1.30–2.04 s) with their echo layers closing in, and a thread starts to draw out from the bulb pin.

scenes.title: Threaded system and resolve
scenes.purpose: Connect every node with copper thread and resolve into a readable, settled collage.
visuals: Copper thread draws node to node. Each pin pops in only when its thread reaches it
'a connected system.' rises in pale type on slate
Dark tape label scales in, then its text fades in

beats.development: The threads A→B, A→D, D→C and B→C complete and the pins arrive. The second headline settles by 2.4 s. The FIG. 1 tape is complete at 2.2 s and its label is legible by 2.36 s.
Fully settled hold. All copy is legible and nothing moves.

findings: The primary focus moves left to right: sketch, tear, disc, nodes, thread, then the closing line, so the eye follows the thread's direction.
The tear is the one large action. It gets a 0.22 s anticipation lift before a 0.48 s accelerating exit.
Node entrances overlap by about 0.1 s, so they read as one assembly gesture rather than four separate events.
The composition is settled by 2.46 s (last pin pop), inside the 2.7 s limit.
justifiedHolds: 2.5–3.0 s: final reading hold for the full two-line statement and tape label.

notes: No reviewed preview recipe was supplied (tech.preview_recipes is absent and the recipe list is []). This refresh instead shows techniques taken from the source-frame review: a paper-tear ground swap (light newsprint to dark slate), a radial-wipe halftone build with a dashed guide ring, a line-draw sweep, and misregistered offset print echoes.

Background is a scene-dependent alternative to the earlier warm cream: deep slate dot-screen print ground plus cool newsprint. Accent families (teal #688E87, copper #B97A5C, ink #263236) are kept from the style example.
